card.statement:
In Ginzburg’s approach to the geometric Satake equivalence [Gi], the maximal torus in $G^{\vee}_{\mathbf{k}}$ is instead constructed using equivariant cohomology and the functors of co-restriction to points $L_{\lambda}$ . For a comparison between these points of view, the reader may consult [GR].

5.2 Dimension estimates

Recall from §3.1 that $\rho$ denotes
the halfsum of the positive roots, considered as a linear form
$X_{*}(T)\to\frac{1}{2}\mathbf{Z}$ , and that $Q^{\vee}\subset X_{*}(T)$ denotes the coroot lattice.
card.label: Remark 5.1

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
